Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

IT Support Specialist

About the Role

6sense is looking for an IT Support Specialist who is passionate about delivering exceptional employee experiences through world-class IT support. This role combines hands-on end user support with administration of modern workplace technologies, identity systems, SaaS applications, endpoint management, and AI platforms.

You'll support a global workforce while helping improve IT operations through automation, documentation, and process improvement. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and creating scalable solutions that make employees more productive.

What You'll Do

- Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support through tickets, chat, email, and remote support sessions.

- Support macOS, Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, and Zoom environments.

- Manage user lifecycle processes including onboarding, offboarding, access requests, and role changes.

- Administer and troubleshoot Okta, Entra ID, SSO, MFA, and identity-related services.

- Support and manage SaaS platforms including Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, 1Password, GitHub, Claude Enterprise, and Workato.

- Deploy, configure, and maintain endpoints using Intune, Iru, and CrowdStrike.

- Maintain accurate asset inventory and device lifecycle management.

- Support Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other AI technologies while promoting responsible AI practices.

- Develop scripts, automations, and workflow improvements that reduce manual effort and improve efficiency.

- Create and maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.

- Provide occasional support for Zoom Rooms, Teams meetings, executive users, and company events.

What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in IT Support, Help Desk, Service Desk, or End User Computing.

- Experience supporting macOS and Windows environments.

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, and Zoom.

- Familiarity with identity and access management concepts including Okta, Entra ID, SSO, and MFA.

- Experience with endpoint management tools such as Intune, Iru, or similar MDM platforms.

- Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills.

- Experience working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

- Basic scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Workato, or similar tools.

- Interest in AI technologies such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude.

- Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Bonus Points

- Experience administering Okta, Entra ID, Intune, or Iru.

- Experience with Workato or workflow automation platforms.

- Experience supporting AI platforms and governance practices.

- ITIL, Okta, Microsoft, Apple, or security-related certifications.

- Experience supporting executive stakeholders and globally distributed teams.

Success in This Role

You'll thrive in this role if you're customer-obsessed, highly organized, technically curious, and motivated to improve how IT services are delivered. Success will be measured through service quality, SLA performance, knowledge sharing, asset management accuracy, and contributions to automation and process improvement.

Base Salary Range: $73,577.25 - $103,913.30. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

- In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

- PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

Position Overview

When a nurse can't reach the right physician at 2am, or a critical alert isn't routing where it should, our Support Specialists are the ones who fix it. Join PerfectServe's 24/7/365 support team and help keep clinical communication running for the hospitals, physicians, and care teams who depend on it.

The Role

As a Support Specialist, you'll support and troubleshoot for PerfectServe's end users, physicians, nurses, and system administrators. Day to day, that means user account management, end-user education, on-call schedule management, mobile and web application support, and hands-on troubleshooting.

Compensation and Schedule

- $19/hour to start + shift differential for nights/weekends, plus a comprehensive benefits package effective on day one

- Most schedules include one weekend day and some holiday coverage

- We're currently hiring for both day and night shifts

- Fully remote within the United States

- Able to start by November 16, 2026

Training

New hires onboard and train together on a Monday through Friday, daytime (EST) schedule, with mentorship before moving to your permanent shift. We expect 100% attendance during your first 60 days, this nesting period is what sets you up to succeed once you're on your own.

What You’re Bringing

- A dedicated, distraction-free home workspace with hardwired or verified reliable high-speed internet, this is a remote, mission-critical support role, so a stable setup matters from day one

- A track record of troubleshooting through complex issues methodically, be ready to walk us through a real example: what broke, how you worked the problem, and how you resolved it

- Experience supporting customers across multiple channels, phone, chat, and ticketing systems, and comfort managing escalations across all three

- A pattern of growth in past roles: taking on more responsibility, training others, or earning a promotion, rather than a string of short, similar stints

- Real interest in what PerfectServe does and why healthcare communication matters to you, we'd rather hear that than "the schedule works for me"

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- High customer empathy and a genuine drive to help people

- Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities

- Willingness to work evenings, overnights, and/or weekends

What You’ll Be Doing

- Field incoming client communications via phone, chat, and our online customer portal

- Help end-users administer their PerfectServe applications and train them on our phone, mobile, and web tools

- Troubleshoot message delivery and content issues, from root-cause diagnosis through configuration fixes

- Build and revise user accounts based on established standards

- Partner with hospital IT teams to resolve mobile and web connectivity issues

- Consult on and configure custom application builds to fit end-user workflows

- Collaborate with customer success, integration, and technical teams on escalated issues

Our Team, Our Culture

We're a distributed team, and we keep cameras on for internal and external meetings, it's a small thing that keeps us connected and engaged even when we're not in the same room.

About PerfectServe

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

Environment, Physical & Other Requirements

This position requires interaction with people and technology while either standing or sitting. In order to best service our customers on the phone, face-to-face, or on the computer, all employees must be able to communicate with or without reasonable accommodation. Depending on the assignment, may require ordinary ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; or the ability to stand, walk and manipulate (lift, carry, move) light to medium weights of 10 - 50 pounds. Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm, hand and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard, operate equipment and read technical information.

PerfectServe is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship.

This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. PerfectServe, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer -----M/F/D/V.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.
We offer a compensation range at $19.00 USD / hour, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support.We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

- Remote first work environment

- Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.

- 401K - with match and immediately vested.

- 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy

- Internal Advancement Opportunities

jobs.description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Caitlin, Senior Manager, Technical Support at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an Email Deliverability Specialist to join our deliverability program within Technical Support. You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing.

You'll be one of several deliverability experts on a team that shares knowledge across Technical Support, so your work reaches well beyond your own queue. You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes.

You'll thrive here if you think about the health of the whole program, enjoy improving how work gets done, and are equally comfortable digging into a detailed case and having a direct conversation with a customer about acceptable use.

What we value

Empathy and curiosity: You approach every customer with patience and a desire to dig deeper, especially when a conversation gets uncomfortable.

Clarity: You explain complex technical concepts simply and help others do the same.

Collaboration: You build strong partnerships across Support, Customer Success, and Engineering, and you treat customer outcomes as a shared goal.

Thinking at scale: You look at how we do things today and see what could work better for the whole organization, then you help make it happen.

Continuous learning: You stay ahead of evolving standards and see change as a chance to improve how we work.

What you'll do

- Act as a trusted deliverability advisor to customers, handling complex cases through to full resolution and leading customer calls when a conversation needs it

- Audit sender setup and monitor reputation across IPs and domains, using authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and BIMI, DNS configuration, and provider tools like Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and Microsoft SNDS to diagnose blocklists, spam traps, and engagement drops

- Work through highly technical issues with Engineering, taking ownership of the investigation first and sharing trends from customer cases with Product and Engineering

- Identify acceptable use policy violations and spam complaints, hold clear and direct conversations with customers about compliance, and keep up with evolving standards (Gmail and Yahoo sender requirements, CAN-SPAM, GDPR)

- Equip CSMs and Technical Support with the knowledge to handle deliverability conversations, through coaching, documentation, and training

- Improve processes, tools, and one-to-many resources, such as help content, Academy course and proactive customer guidance, so deliverability support scales across the organization

What we're looking for

- 2-4 years of experience in email deliverability at a mid-size or large ESP, B2B SaaS company, or marketing automation platform, with exposure to deliverability at scale

- Deep understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI) and infrastructure (SMTP, MTAs, DNS), with the technical comfort to work through complex issues with Engineering

- Proficiency with provider data feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, Microsoft SNDS) and third-party deliverability monitoring tools like Everest, MXToolbox, or similar, and the analytical skill to turn bounce, engagement, and blocklist data into clear recommendations

- Working knowledge of email compliance and acceptable use standards, and comfort having direct conversations with customers who are sending outside of them

- Experience building or improving processes, documentation, or training that help a support or deliverability team scale

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort leading customer calls and simplifying technical concepts for any audience

- Located in the United States or Canada

- Bonus: participation in deliverability communities (M3AAWG, ESPC, or similar) and experience partnering with Customer Success teams

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $102,000 - $110,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

- 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

- 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

- 60 minute Case Study Review call with Cross-Functional Partners

- 30 minute video call with potential Team Member

- 30 minute final video call with Senior Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

-

A proven track record of spotting exciting opportunities, keeping a healthy pipeline moving, and turning great conversations into signed business.

-
You stay on top of your day, always deliver on what you promise, and keep your pipeline and records tidy and up to date.

Experience in the New Zealand electricity market is a lovely bonus, but it's definitely not essential! If you're a great B2B salesperson who is curious, adaptable, and excited to dive into a new space, we want to hear from you.

We’ll give you all the training and support you need to master the energy sector, our products, and our Kraken platform. Above all, what counts is your attitude, your appetite to learn, and your drive to turn effort into real impact.

This turns out to be a pretty wild endeavor, so we’re looking to bring someone smart onto our Customer Support team to help us out.

As a member of our Customer Support team, you’ll make sure our users are charmed by warmth and competence when they have questions or needs that aren’t being met by our product. You’ll radiate intelligence while exercising your best human qualities, like compassion and empathy, even in the face of frustration.

You’ll need to understand how our product works in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You’ll Do:

- Answer user questions over chat, email, and phone

- Handle user account requests, including application processing, card disputes, missing payments, card shipments, and a whole lot more

- Teach customers how to use our product (hopefully most of it is self-explanatory), and translate user confusion into product suggestions

- Identify the systemic flaws that lead to user problems

- Work with our engineering team to find and squash bugs

- Communicate our users' needs to our partner banks and work with them to improve their products and processes

- Write help articles and FAQs

- Learn our internal tools and figure out how to improve them

- Put in place processes to make your job more efficient

- Help with other compliance and customer tasks

- Create and sustain warm relationships with our users

- Help build out the customer support and ops infrastructure at Mercury

What You Bring:

- Have 2+ years of experience in a Customer Experience / Customer Support role

- Consistently exercise empathy

- Always seek to answer the question behind the question

- Understand how to translate complex terminology into clear, human user communication

- Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible

- Keep a clean, ordered inbox

- Stay calm and collected while working on ten things at once

- Feel confident talking with startup folks in person, over chat, or on the phone

- Use creativity while working within difficult constraints

- Show kindness in the face of unpleasantness (our customers generally are really great, but they can get passionate when it comes to their businesses)

Would be nice if you:

- Have experience working in retail branch banking

- Are passionate about uncovering customer needs

- Enjoy solving customer problems and proactively offering solutions to unmet needs

Schedule Information:

- Required: be available to work at least one weekend day per 5 day shift

- We are currently hiring for multiple shifts. Openings will be covered early in the interview process

- Your working schedule will be fixed - this is long-term commitment, not a rotating shift

jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

- Planejar e executar operações ofensivas (Red Team engagements, Adversary Simulation/Emulation) contra a infraestrutura, aplicações e processos do iFood Pago, simulando adversários reais com foco em impacto financeiro.

- Realizar testes de segurança em aplicações web, APIs (REST/GraphQL/gRPC) e aplicações mobile (Android e iOS), incluindo análise estática, dinâmica e de runtime.

- Realizar testes e avaliar a segurança de ambientes cloud-native, incluindo Kubernetes, containers, service meshes.

- Conduzir testes de segurança em sistemas AI-powered, identificando vulnerabilidades como prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning, bypass de guardrails, entre outras.

- Desenvolver automações, ferramentas ofensivas e integrações utilizando AI/LLMs para escalar processos e aprimorar a identificação e exploração de vulnerabilidades.

- Documentar findings com clareza, demonstrando impacto real ao negócio e propondo planos de ações para correção.

- Colaborar com Blue Team e CSIRT em exercícios de Purple Team, contribuindo para melhoria contínua de detecção e resposta.

- Manter-se atualizado sobre TTPs emergentes, especialmente aquelas direcionadas ao setor financeiro e de pagamentos na América Latina.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

- Experiência em Red Team operations e Penetration Testing em ambientes corporativos.

- Domínio em testes de segurança de aplicações web e APIs, incluindo vulnerabilidades além do OWASP Top 10 (broken authentication, mass assignment, BOLA/IDOR, race conditions, business logic flaws em fluxos financeiros).

- Experiência em segurança mobile (Android/iOS): reversing de APKs/IPAs, hooking com Frida, bypass de certificate pinning, análise de armazenamento local, etc.

- Conhecimento prático em segurança de ambientes cloud-native: Kubernetes (RBAC, pod escape, service account abuse), Docker (container breakout), AWS/GCP (privilege escalation, misconfiguration exploitation).

- Experiência com infraestrutura de Red Team: C2 frameworks (Cobalt Strike, Sliver, custom C2), redirectors, OPSEC, evasão e persistência.

- Habilidade em programação e scripting (Python, Go, Bash) para desenvolvimento de tooling ofensivo e automações.

- Conhecimento do MITRE ATT&CK Framework e capacidade de mapear operações a TTPs relevantes.

- Familiaridade com protocolos e sistemas financeiros é um diferencial forte.

- Traduzir findings técnicos em risco de negócio para diferentes audiências.

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Experiência em testes de segurança de sistemas baseados em LLMs/AI (prompt injection, jailbreaking, tool-use abuse, data exfiltration via AI agents).

- Uso de AI/LLMs para automação de tarefas ofensivas (triagem de vulnerabilidades, geração de payloads, análise de código, reconhecimento automatizado).

- Participação em programas de bug bounty com track record relevante.

- Publicação de pesquisas, CVEs, write-ups ou palestras em conferências de segurança.

- Certificações relevantes (OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, CRTO, CARTE, CRT, eMAPT).

- Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos ou empresas de pagamentos.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança da informação, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Caitlin, Senior Manager, Technical Support at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an Email Deliverability Specialist to join our deliverability program within Technical Support. You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing.

You'll be one of several deliverability experts on a team that shares knowledge across Technical Support, so your work reaches well beyond your own queue. You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes.

You'll thrive here if you think about the health of the whole program, enjoy improving how work gets done, and are equally comfortable digging into a detailed case and having a direct conversation with a customer about acceptable use.

What we value

Empathy and curiosity: You approach every customer with patience and a desire to dig deeper, especially when a conversation gets uncomfortable.

Clarity: You explain complex technical concepts simply and help others do the same.

Collaboration: You build strong partnerships across Support, Customer Success, and Engineering, and you treat customer outcomes as a shared goal.

Thinking at scale: You look at how we do things today and see what could work better for the whole organization, then you help make it happen.

Continuous learning: You stay ahead of evolving standards and see change as a chance to improve how we work.

What you'll do

- Act as a trusted deliverability advisor to customers, handling complex cases through to full resolution and leading customer calls when a conversation needs it

- Audit sender setup and monitor reputation across IPs and domains, using authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and BIMI, DNS configuration, and provider tools like Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and Microsoft SNDS to diagnose blocklists, spam traps, and engagement drops

- Work through highly technical issues with Engineering, taking ownership of the investigation first and sharing trends from customer cases with Product and Engineering

- Identify acceptable use policy violations and spam complaints, hold clear and direct conversations with customers about compliance, and keep up with evolving standards (Gmail and Yahoo sender requirements, CAN-SPAM, GDPR)

- Equip CSMs and Technical Support with the knowledge to handle deliverability conversations, through coaching, documentation, and training

- Improve processes, tools, and one-to-many resources, such as help content, Academy course and proactive customer guidance, so deliverability support scales across the organization

What we're looking for

- 2-4 years of experience in email deliverability at a mid-size or large ESP, B2B SaaS company, or marketing automation platform, with exposure to deliverability at scale

- Deep understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI) and infrastructure (SMTP, MTAs, DNS), with the technical comfort to work through complex issues with Engineering

- Proficiency with provider data feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, Microsoft SNDS) and third-party deliverability monitoring tools like Everest, MXToolbox, or similar, and the analytical skill to turn bounce, engagement, and blocklist data into clear recommendations

- Working knowledge of email compliance and acceptable use standards, and comfort having direct conversations with customers who are sending outside of them

- Experience building or improving processes, documentation, or training that help a support or deliverability team scale

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort leading customer calls and simplifying technical concepts for any audience

- Located in the United States or Canada

- Bonus: participation in deliverability communities (M3AAWG, ESPC, or similar) and experience partnering with Customer Success teams

jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

O Data Security Specialist é um profissional técnico responsável pela execução e operação dos controles de segurança de dados corporativos e de produção do iFood. Essa posição atua na interseção entre engenharia de segurança, proteção de dados e execução técnica — implementando controles, investigando incidentes e operando as ferramentas que protegem os ativos de dados do iFood.
O Data Security Specialist executa as operações de segurança de dados, impulsiona a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho diários de segurança e garante que as capacidades de proteção de dados acompanhem o crescimento do iFood. É uma posição de contribuidor individual que exige experiência prática comprovada em engenharia de segurança de dados, com capacidade de atuar tanto no ambiente corporativo quanto no de produção.

Segurança de Dados Corporativos

- Operar e evoluir os controles de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) para endpoints, aplicações em cloud e canais de comunicação — implementando políticas, ajustando regras e executando as prioridades trimestrais.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de classificação de dados e procedimentos de tratamento para usuários internos e terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com LGPD, GDPR e requisitos regulatórios (BACEN, PCI-DSS, entre outros).

- Configurar e manter os controles de segurança para plataformas corporativas de SaaS: Databricks, Salesforce, Google Workspace, outras plataformas e ferramentas emergentes baseadas em AI — estabelecendo baselines de hardening, controles de acesso e governança de configuração.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de Document Retention & Disposal — estabelecendo cronogramas de retenção, procedimentos de descarte e mecanismos automatizados de aplicação.

- Executar o programa de insider threat: ajustar regras de behavioral analytics, conduzir cadências de análise de anomalias e coordenar com HR e Legal os casos de risco elevado.

- Gerenciar políticas de device posture e a aplicação de ZTNA, garantindo o acesso de dispositivos em conformidade em todo o ambiente corporativo.

Segurança de Dados de Produção

- Conduzir revisões de segurança da arquitetura de dados de produção: avaliar integrações de dados entre sistemas internos, parceiros e clientes, identificando riscos em APIs, pipelines de ETL e padrões de transferência de arquivos.

- Executar o workstream de Data Security no processo de Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de IT Risk e contribuindo continuamente para a melhoria dos security review gates, dos requisitos contratuais de segurança e do monitoramento contínuo dos arranjos de troca de dados com terceiros.

- Promover security-by-design nas equipes de engenharia e dados: incorporar requisitos de proteção de dados aos padrões de desenho de integrações, aos frameworks de governança de APIs e aos controles de data residency.

- Garantir que data residency, criptografia em trânsito e em repouso e modelos de controle de acesso atendam às obrigações regulatórias e contratuais em todos os ambientes de produção.

- Apoiar os programas de conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS) relacionados à proteção de dados, atuando como ponto de contato técnico de Data Security para as equipes de Legal, Compliance e Audit.

Adoção de AI e Resultados Mensuráveis

- Impulsionar a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho de Data Security: implementar ferramentas de AI para detecção de padrões anômalos de dados, classificação automatizada de dados, ajuste de políticas de DLP e aceleração de investigações — com melhorias mensuráveis na velocidade de detecção, na redução de falsos positivos e na produtividade dos analistas.

- Contribuir para o workstream de Data Security para AI Security, atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de AI Security para melhorar continuamente a governança e definir requisitos de proteção de dados para ferramentas de AI, incluindo casos de uso aprovados, tratamento de dados sensíveis em prompts, controles de acesso, monitoramento e padrões de adoção.

- Acompanhar e reportar os resultados impulsionados por AI: quantificar o tempo economizado, os riscos detectados mais cedo e as melhorias na precisão da classificação atribuíveis às ferramentas de AI.

Colaboração Cross-functional e Resposta a Incidentes

- Atuar como referência técnica de Data Security para as equipes adjacentes: traduzir cenários complexos de riscos relacionados a dados em atualizações claras e contextualizadas pelo impacto no negócio para o Data Security Manager e para os times de segurança.

- Construir e manter o dashboard operacional de Data Security: tendências de risco, taxas de violações de políticas, SLAs de remediação, métricas de adoção de AI e status operacional.

- Participar de iniciativas cross-functional de Data Security: coordenar com Legal, Product, Engineering e IT para equilibrar requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio — encontrando o caminho seguro que viabilize a entrega de produtos.

- Gerenciar solicitações de exceção de Data Security: avaliar exceções baseadas em risco às políticas de segurança, documentar recomendações e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das exceções.

- Atuar na resposta a incidentes como referência técnica de Data Security: conduzir a frente de investigação específica de dados durante incidentes de grande impacto, coordenar com o CSIRT e comunicar o impacto do risco relacionado a dados ao Data Security Manager.

Operação Técnica de Programas

- Executar o roadmap técnico de Data Security: traduzir as metas estratégicas em tarefas operacionais, gerenciar o acompanhamento de dependências e reportar o progresso ao Data Security Manager.

- Conduzir iniciativas de Sensitive Data Mapping: executar a descoberta, classificação e catalogação cross-functional de dados nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.

- Construir e manter métricas de Data Security: índices de exposição a riscos, tendências de violações de políticas, taxas de encerramento de alertas de DLP, SLAs de remediação e velocidade operacional.

- Documentar e manter runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais padrão para as operações de Data Security.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

- Experiência comprovada como Data Security Specialist, Analyst ou Engineer — com histórico de responsabilidade técnica por um domínio de Data Security.

- Forte experiência em proteção de dados, DLP, ZTNA e governança de segurança da informação.

- Sólida compreensão dos princípios de arquitetura Zero Trust e de sua implementação prática: ZTNA, conditional access, device posture e identity-based segmentation.

- Conhecimento profundo de hardening de segurança de SaaS corporativo: Google Workspace, Salesforce, Databricks, outras plataformas e plataformas emergentes baseadas em AI.

- Conhecimento de conceitos de arquitetura de dados: APIs, pipelines de ETL, data warehouses, plataformas de dados em cloud e padrões de troca de dados de produção.

- Familiaridade com frameworks regulatórios: LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS e requisitos regulatórios do BACEN e do PROUF.

- Experiência prática com ferramentas de AI para Data Security: detecção de anomalias, classificação automatizada, ajuste de DLP ou aceleração de investigações — com resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis documentados.

- Sólidas habilidades analíticas e investigativas: capacidade de rastrear um vazamento de dados, desde o sinal até a causa-raiz, e traduzir as descobertas em recomendações sistêmicas.

- Capacidade de colaboração cross-functional: aptidão para conduzir resultados técnicos em colaboração com Legal, Engineering, Product e IT, equilibrando requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio.

- Habilidade de documentação e criação de runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais para Data Security.

- Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Experiência com plataformas SASE (Netskope, Zscaler ou similares) e ferramentas de DSPM (Netskope, Cyera, Wiz ou similares).

- Experiência em data engineering ou analytics — compreensão dos fluxos de dados por dentro, incluindo arquitetura de pipelines, data warehousing e plataformas de dados em tempo real.

- Experiência na adoção de AI em Data Security: implementação de ferramentas de AI para operações de segurança, mensuração de ganhos de produtividade e iteração das estratégias de adoção.

- Certificações: CISM, CDPSE, CISSP ou equivalente.

- Experiência em um setor regulado (fintech, banking, payments, health tech), com exposição prática à conformidade regulatória.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança em tecnologia, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

As a regulated payment provider, we must ensure we manage operational risk and our regulatory requirements correctly. We do this by having a robust control framework across some of our business-critical areas, like payments and billing.

This role will be central to ensuring our 1st line Operations teams continue to implement, manage, test and regularly update controls frameworks. You'll manage the end-to-end controls framework for our operational teams, including but not limited to Payments Operations, Billing and Credit Control. - Direct control management. Managing key controls within our Internal Operations teams

- Understanding existing processes and re-designing controls to meet current and future business needs

- Working with the Regulatory team to ensure audits are completed successfully, including explaining our first-line controls to auditors and regulators

- Improving efficiency through the standardisation, automation or removal of controls

Bei Octopus Electric Vehicles (OEV) Germany gestalten wir die Mobilität der Zukunft direkt am Arbeitsplatz. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die gerne beraten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam etwas Neues aufzubauen.

jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.

You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.

You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.

You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.

What We're Looking For

Required

- 3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role

- Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs

- Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment

- Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models

- Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal

- Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration

- Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification

- Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.

30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.

60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.

90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.

Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

Other Types of Pay: Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.

Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Stiamo cercando un* Junior Office Manager pragmatic*, energic* e super organizzat*.

Cerchiamo una persona con una grande attitudine pratica, la voglia di imparare e l'entusiasmo di "sporcarsi le mani" ogni giorno per far funzionare la nostra sede come un orologio, sempre con il sorriso e la voglia di creare un ambiente accogliente.

Sarai il punto di riferimento operativo per la vita quotidiana del nostro ufficio. In questo ruolo c’è da rimboccarsi le maniche e gestire aspetti sia pratici che logistici:

-
Gestione operativa dell'ufficio: dalla manutenzione quotidiana al riordino degli spazi, dal monitoraggio delle forniture (cancelleria, snack, dotazioni) alla risoluzione dei piccoli e grandi imprevisti pratici di ogni giorno.

-
Interfaccia con fornitori e manutentori: sarai tu a coordinare gli interventi tecnici, i servizi di pulizia e la sicurezza, assicurandoti che tutto sia sempre efficiente e a norma.

-
Accoglienza e logistica: accoglierai ospiti, candidati e colleghi, gestirai la posta/corrieri e ti assicurerai che le sale riunioni e le postazioni siano sempre pronte ed equipaggiate.

-
Supporto al team e agli eventi: darai un aiuto concreto nell'organizzazione dei momenti di condivisione aziendali come il nostro Family Dinner del venerdì!

-
Proattività quotidiana: non aspetterai che siano gli altri a notare che qualcosa non va: ti anticipi, trovi soluzioni semplici e ti assicuri che l'ufficio sia un posto fantastico in cui lavorare.

-
Attitudine da “risolutore di problemi” e concretezza: non hai paura di metterti in gioco in prima persona, ti piace l'operatività e trovi soddisfazione nel risolvere i problemi sul campo in modo rapido e pratico.

-

-
Energia e spirito di iniziativa: sei una persona dinamica, solare e positiva. Se c'è da spostare uno scatolone, riordinare una sala o gestire un'emergenza dell'ultimo minuto, sei il* prim* a dare una mano.

-
Precisione e doti organizzative: anche nel caos saprai prioritizzare le urgenze e tenere tutto sotto controllo senza perdere il filo.

-

Experience leading complex commercial processes and managing external counterparties, including PPA, route-to-market, optimiser or trading arrangements

Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

jobs.description:
Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.
 
Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie.
 
Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Business Development, Strategie, Projektmanagement – und das alles am liebsten gleichzeitig? Dann suchen wir genau dich. Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) wirst du zur rechten Hand unserer CFO und zum Motor abteilungsübergreifender Projekte. Kein Tag wie der andere, kein Problem zu groß.

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
In Octopus Energy crediamo che le strutture burocratiche tradizionali rischino spesso di infantilizzare le persone e soffocare la creatività. Le persone adulte non hanno bisogno di rigide regole dall'alto, ma di autonomia, responsabilità e fiducia.
Non cerchiamo un HR tradizionale che imponga processi o "gestisca" le persone per conto dei manager. Cerchiamo una figura di People Operations capace di costruire strumenti e percorsi fluidi (come il nostro onboarding automatizzato) per rimuovere gli ostacoli e dare a ogni team il supporto per esprimersi al meglio fin dal primo giorno.

Gestione Contratti e Onboarding: Redazione e invio dei contratti di lavoro ai nuovi assunti, monitorando con cura lo stato di avanzamento della documentazione necessaria all’ingresso in azienda.

Supporto ai Team Leader: Gestione operativa delle richieste quotidiane, delle segnalazioni e degli aggiornamenti provenienti dai Team Leader.

Anagrafiche e Gestione Sistemi: Mantenimento e aggiornamento costante dei profili dei colleghi sui nostri sistemi gestionali (cambi di ruolo, variazioni contrattuali).

Miglioramento dei Processi & Automazioni: Contributo attivo all’ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro, alla creazione/manutenzione di template operativi e all'implementazione di automazioni.

Riservatezza e Cura dei Dati: Garanzia che ogni processo amministrativo e informativo sia gestito con massima cura, precisione e rispetto della riservatezza.

Progetti Amministrativi e Supporto Trasversale: Supporto operativo a progetti speciali o ad altre attività amministrative in base alle esigenze del team.

Ottime capacità comunicative: ottima proprietà di linguaggio sia scritta che orale, fondamentale per interagire con trasparenza con colleghi e stakeholder.

Organizzazione e dettaglio: spiccata attenzione ai dettagli, precisione impeccabile e capacità di organizzare le proprie priorità in modo autonomo.

Serietà e riservatezza: Elevata sensibilità nella gestione di informazioni riservate e dati personali.

Attitudine digitale: familiarità con strumenti digitali, software di gestione del personale o tool di produttività, unita alla capacità di imparare velocemente nuovi sistemi.

Spirito di squadra e proattività: attitudine collaborativa, capacità di anticipare i bisogni e orientamento pratico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Flessibilità in ambienti dinamici: abilità nel muoversi con disinvoltura in un contesto in rapida crescita, flessibile e privo di burocrazia inutile.

Conoscenza di base di sistemi o procedure paghe (rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato).

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

Sede: Ancarano/Ascoli Piceno

Ore: Tempo pieno

Presenza in ufficio: Si

jobs.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality.

This could not be a better time to join Octopus Energy. We are already recognised as a global leader in the fight to decarbonise the planet by revolutionising what’s possible in energy - including investments in renewable energy supply, renewable energy generation, smart energy networks, EVs, heat pumps, etc. The government's new green initiatives and the recent investment by Al Gore’s Generation Fund will propel us further and faster.
We’re taking Tenant Power to the next level. We’ve moved past the early trial phase and are ready to scale things up.
Your mission in this role is to make sure our installations are consistent, super straightforward for installers, and transition smoothly from "ready to go" to fully live and running.
This is a hands-on, field-based role. You won’t be chained to a desk. Instead, you’ll spend plenty of time out on-site working alongside housing associations, third-party installers, suppliers, and our internal teams.
You’ll get to see how things actually work in the real world, help teams get it "right first time," and bring back practical site feedback to help us build better guides, training, and future plans.
Your main goal is keeping things running like clockwork. You’ll support our installers by helping them get a clear grip on:
The Blueprint: The approved Tenant Power design and kit requirements.
The Process: The installation sequence and what we need to see to sign it off.
The Finish Line: What’s required to get the data flowing and officially go live.
Just to keep things clear on who does what:
The Installers: They are independent contractors, usually chosen and hired directly by the housing association or delivery partner.
Octopus: We support the model by setting the technical standards, design rules, and go-live conditions.
The Responsibility: While we are there to guide them, the installers and the partners who hired them are still responsible for the actual site safety, compliance, workmanship, and final certifications.

1. Hands-on on-site support

-
Get stuck in on-site: You’ll work side-by-side with installers during their first setups, live installs, and any troubleshooting runs. You'll help them master the Tenant Power design, meter setups, and what's needed for sign-off.

-
Bridge the gap: You'll collaborate with the OE Homes Delivery team to make sure our guides are actually useful on a busy site. This means making sure instructions for kit setups, battery/inverter wiring, meter placement, and data monitoring are crystal clear.

-
Set teams up for success: Before a single tool is lifted, you'll help make sure the installers truly understand the technical requirements, approved kit lists, and platform guides so there are no surprises midway through.

2. Learning, improving, and scaling

-
Spot what works (and what doesn't): You'll keep an eye out for what makes an install breeze through, as well as the hiccups that cause delays, missing data, or "installed-but-not-yet-live" limbo. You'll use these insights to help us build a smoother, repeatable process.

-
Be the feedback loop: Keep track of common installer questions, repeating issues, or confusing instructions. You’ll feed this real-world feedback straight back to our design, training, and standards teams so we can keep improving.

-
Pick the right battles: Use your on-site knowledge to help prioritize which properties or batches are genuinely ready to go, ensuring we focus on the projects most likely to transition smoothly to live operation.

3. Collaboration and alignment

-
Empower our installers: Since they are independent contractors, your job is to coach them on our standards and design intent. You'll help them confidently deliver high-quality work that matches our blueprint every time.

-
Bring everyone together: You'll act as the connector between housing associations, installers, supply chain, data, and delivery teams, helping to smooth out any friction points in the journey from "installed" to "live."

-
proven experience supporting or delivering domestic solar PV and battery

storage installations and necessary qualifications

- Practical experience with battery commissioning, inverter setup, export settings and monitoring platforms;

-

Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Tax Assistant Manager / emerging Tax Manager to join the OEGen Tax Team, reporting directly to the Funds & Deals Tax Lead. The successful candidate will join the tax function at Sky Generation, the UK clean energy infrastructure platform of the Sky Fund, which owns and manages a number of international operating platforms. These businesses are active across Europe and beyond, developing, investing in and managing renewable energy and broader energy transition assets.
This is a strong opportunity for someone with around 4–5 years’ experience who is looking to step into a broader international role and continue developing their technical, commercial and project management capabilities within a growing infrastructure investment environment.

The role will support the Sky Fund’s portfolio and associated holding structures across multiple jurisdictions. You will work closely with investment teams, finance teams, portfolio companies and external advisers on a broad range of tax matters, including tax compliance oversight, reporting, transactions, structuring and ongoing portfolio support.
The position offers wide exposure to international investment structures, cross-border transactions and the full lifecycle of infrastructure investments, while working within a collaborative, hands-on and growing in-house tax team.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal tax processes and documentation.

- Good grounding in tax compliance, reporting, and tax accounting.

- Exposure to cross-border structures or international tax matters is helpful, but deep expertise is not expected.

- An interest in infrastructure, energy, or investment management is a plus.

- Foreign language skills (particularly German, French, Spanish, or Italian) would be beneficial but are not required.

- Most importantly, we are looking for someone with strong reasoning skills, good commercial awareness, and a willingness to learn. - Erfahrung in der operativen Umsetzung von Datenschutzanforderungen in kunden- und datenintensiven Prozessen.

- Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen verständlich und praxisnah zu übersetzen.

- Hohe Eigenständigkeit und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
